summary: Q-Potato is a potato trading company in Lemmer, Friesland, Netherlands, that buys and sells seed and ware potatoes, mainly grown on clay soils. It was formed in 2014 by merging ATF Potato BV and Q-Potato Holland BV. Its seed trade focuses on free (non-proprietary) varieties, mostly supplied by growers under pool contracts.
